g.text: Note U3 is populated as follows: WIG-20636 (25-voice): ATSAMS70N19A-AN WIG-18159 (32-voice): ATSAMS70N20A-AN
Footprint for Serial Basic. ** 3.3V Logic ONLY **
S2 is optional, side-firing 6mm tact type.
Power inputs prioritize header over USB. If 5V is present on both, current is drawn from header.
Revision by: Jamie Robertson, Pete Lewis
S4 is optional, side-firing 6mm tact type.
Status LED Blue On while files are playing.
This jumper connects SDA and SCL to 4.7k pull-up resistors.
UIA1 through UIA4 Serve double-pourpse as Triggers 13 to 16, or analog inputs 1 to 4.
Close 3V3_Qwiic Jumper To power Qwiic devices From Tsunami.
